summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs with coordinates computed from padded slices minus padding offset; set_rnd skips double-underscore attribute names); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator with channel-prepended patch_size, ensure_tuple-normalized start_pos, NumpyPadMode validation; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with NumPy ceiling worker split, transform applied to patch alone, and the exact missing-len NotImplementedError; math import removed; PatchDataset docstring float alias fixed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds test_shape, test_loading_array as specified, plus a test_missing_len case. Choices: test images are np.arange(16, dtype=float).reshape(1, 4, 4) for both items; the GridPatchDataset docstring example prints only shapes and its output was derived by reasoning. Unverified: pinned test values and the docstring example, since tests were not run. Known gap: utils.py lines 231-233 (get_valid_patch_size docstring, untouched) exceed 120 characters and were left as-is to preserve unrelated lines.
